prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. New full-color fantasy manga character INTRODUCTION demonstration page, landscape 16:9, FIVE PANELS with left 42% large tall panel and four right panels in a 2x2 grid. Input1 is CHARACTER IDENTITY reference: TOP row HUMAN KING, BOTTOM row CHANCELLOR. Preserve both faces faithfully across angles, including hairline, nose, eyelids, cheek/jaw shape, facial hair and clothes. Input2 is comic STYLE/CITY reference only. DO NOT copy its civilians as protagonists. Chancellor must be the clean-shaven long-oval-faced mature man with side-parted charcoal hair and silver temples, composed grey-brown eyes, smoky teal court robe and brass clasps; king the broad rounded auburn-bearded man with heavy eyelids and short broad nose, blue/gold royal coat and gold crown. No invented names, no new hero, no coronation, no murder plan or culprit confession. This is a PROPOSED dramatization of existing political ambition, not approved canon. Mature full-color manga inks, detailed established kingdom marble halls, refined anatomy, clear speech balloon tails, large EXACT Traditional Chinese text only, no English or watermark.
Small title 「會面之後」.
Large LEFT panel: PUBLIC reception hall, Chancellor in prominent waist-up three-quarter view politely speaking to gathered ordinary delegates of green Silverleaf and purple Shadowfolk seen smaller in background. His face clearly recognizable with gentle, credible expression, not villain smirk. Natural open-hand welcoming gesture. Elegant integrated introductory cartouche clear of face: big 「首相」, smaller 「人類王國・政務重臣」. His speech balloon 「王子的經驗，確實值得各族信任。」 Do NOT depict prince himself.
RIGHT top-left panel: transition to private interior hall, small location caption 「稍後・內廳」. HUMAN KING in clear large three-quarter bust turns toward chancellor, controlled displeasure. Introductory small cartouche 「人類王」 with second line 「人類王國的統治者」, no name. King asks 「連你也這麼認為？」
RIGHT top-right: Chancellor close-up, identically long oval face, thoughtful respectful eye contact toward king outside frame, he replies 「我只是擔心，大家往後只聽得見他的聲音。」
RIGHT bottom-left: medium two-shot with chancellor near king, open relaxed hands, absolutely no devil grin or whispering behind hand. Chancellor asks 「到那時，陛下的話，還有多少人會聽？」
RIGHT bottom-right: silent reaction close-up HUMAN KING, mouth closed, brows tense, one hand holding chair arm at edge, chancellor softly out of focus behind with composed neutral face. NO extra text. No threatening weapons or sinister lighting. The manipulation is in the differing public/private wording, not evil appearance. Reader sees who they are and senses pressure without learning the later conspiracy. Preserve face identities especially chancellor's straight nose and king's rounded short nose.
